verdict.rationale: Runloop documents configurable automatic-shutdown and idle behavior for Devboxes, plus suspend/resume that preserves state so an agent can pause, wait for PR feedback and pick up where it left off. That supports long-lived, multi-step agent work, but no evidence states how long a Devbox can stay running continuously. Missing for 10: a documented maximum session lifetime confirming hours or days of continuous runtime, details on idle-timeout limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-day sessions.
